body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> BOYNQ presented a combination of a webcam and a speaker ''Alibi'' during CES 2007. It comes equipped with 1.3M camera with 640x480 resolution while the webcam can rotate 25-degree. A mike is also included.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
